dedupe_keys.name: a 30 meter resolution dataset of impervious surface area and green space fractions of china s cities 2000 2018

description: The Chinese Academy of Sciences and Fujian Normal University publish urban boundaries, impervious-surface fractions and green-space fractions for Chinese cities during 2000–2018. The dataset uses 30 m cells and separates fraction layers by province and mapping year. Zenodo lists GeoTIFFs, an Excel description and mapping examples, all publicly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. Stored fraction values were multiplied by 1,000 and converted to integers; users must apply the documented scaling before modelling. The available mapping dates do not establish annual observations for every year. Remote-sensing classification and mixed pixels limit interpretation of individual roads, roofs or planted areas. The fractions could parameterise rainfall-runoff or urban-heat simulations and support comparisons of changing developed land. They complement binary urban-extent maps by distinguishing impervious and green components inside cities. Pixel values and coordinate systems were not independently checked by downloading files.
